title: Klint Kandinsky
description: Inspired by the pioneering works of Wassily Kandinsky and Hilma af Klint, this project uses p5.js to dynamically generate artwork that captures the essence of abstract painting with a contemporary twist. In the animation, colorful shapes appear to populate a 2D plane, but the point of view rotates to reveal that the shapes have variable depth and occupy 3D space.

media.caption: The algorithmic approach pays homage to the masters of abstract painting and explores the possibilities that emerge when art intersects with technology.

Kandinsky and af Klint were known for their use of vibrant colors and geometric forms. This work is a testament to their enduring influence and an exploration of how their visionary approaches to abstraction can be reinterpreted in the digital age.
